capabilities: Capture first guesses and confidence levels
extras: Works offline by default; online source lookup and AI are opt-in. Browser capture needs the separate Curiosity Capture extension. Cloud AI usage may be billed by the provider. English and Indonesian interface.
problem: Notes can store what you read, but they do not test understanding, calibrate confidence, or track misconceptions for later review.

relations.evidence: Install Curiosity Capture from its local extension package.

requires.name: Local AI CLI or local HTTP server

summary: Learning workflow plugin that records a first guess and confidence, tests understanding with diagnostic modes, and schedules FSRS review.
